# proxmox_node_network_apply (Resource)

Applies the staged network configuration of one Proxmox VE node through `PUT /nodes/{node}/network` and waits for the reload task. `proxmox_node_network_interface` only stages changes, so this resource is the explicit activation step for a whole node. Destroy is a no-op: an applied configuration stays applied. A failed reload keeps the instance in state for a retry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Applies the staged interface configuration of one node in a single reload and
# waits for the reload task. Bump a trigger whenever the staged configuration
# changed; a robust trigger is a hash over the interfaces, for example
#   interfaces = sha1(jsonencode([for i in proxmox_node_network_interface.node1 : [i.id, i.address, i.bridge_ports]]))
# Destroying this resource does not undo the applied configuration.
# Provider credentials need Sys.Modify on /nodes/{node}.
resource "proxmox_node_network_apply" "node1" {
  node = "node1"

  triggers = {
    revision = "2026-11-03"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node whose staged configuration is applied. Changes require replacement.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values that decide when a reload is due; changing any of them re-applies. Use a hash of the managed interfaces, for example `{ interfaces = sha1(jsonencode([for i in proxmox_node_network_interface.this : [i.id, i.address, i.bridge_ports]])) }`.

### Optional

- `regenerate_frr` (Boolean) Regenerate the FRR configuration during the reload. Proxmox only does so when this is set, which is required for SDN/FRR setups.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Apply identifier (the node name).
- `pending_changes` (List of String) Staged but not yet applied changes Proxmox currently reports for the node. Empty after a successful apply.
